sloka: अभ्यधावम् सुसंक्रुद्धः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो मृग आकृतिः ।जिघांसुः अकृतप्रज्ञः तम् प्रहारम् अनुस्मरन् ॥३-३९-१०॥
transliteration: abhyadhāvam susaṁkruddhaḥ tīkṣṇa śṛṁgo mṛga ākṛtiḥ ।jighāṁsuḥ akṛtaprajñaḥ tam prahāram anusmaran ॥3-39-10॥

translations.english: His mighty bow drawn, Rama released three sharp darts that came whizzing like Garuda or the wind. They could destroy the enemy.
